resourceOwner: Room owns all model geometry, materials, textures and imported ImageBitmaps; World owns its renderer, environment targets and only bitmaps it creates separately.
cancellation: Optional AbortSignal aborts model and descriptor acquisition, rejects promptly if descriptor stalls, and disposes resources including late image decodes.

lightmap.gain: Read measured value from matching quality descriptor
lightmap.denoising: Official OIDN2.5 RTLightmap with matched HDR weights; linear float before encoding; raw and denoised EXRs retained in authoring source
